summary: Work uses b- for workplace/activity/material, gab and ʕam/aʕm- for employer or associate, l-/lašan for beneficiaries, and ʕal for a machine or remuneration. None alone licenses a special idiom. 33/73 differs by a zero-marked manufactured product.

Infectum-wa covers habitual labour and an ongoing activity interrupted by a punctual event (MAC Hanna Dewo/242). gəd- with -wo occurs in past manufacturing (Bilgic Der Beruf eines Kesselverzinkers/29); it is not automatically future.
Bare Infectum can occur in past-duration frames (31/6, 31/17, 31/27), purpose clauses (31/8, 31/19), and current work (31/32). Edition tense alone does not determine the form box.
ʕawd-/ʕuwad-/ʕud-/ʕū- variation and the MAC ending -wayna are retained as printed. Editorial <wo> at MAC YT LIFE STORY/72 is restored material, not independent proof of an overt suffix.
III.1 already combines zuspitzen and arbeiten lassen, Arbeit geben. Literal teeth/horn sharpening is covered; preserve label 1 and ask editors about a future split with all existing examples tracked.
Lookup confirms → ʕwḏ has no entry in the supplied snapshot; ʕwḏ̣ concerns replacement and is not a correction target for the working or sharpening uses.
54/1, 63/23 and 75/169 are compact occurrence records with no verses. Their supplied classifications are retained provisionally; they cannot be independently checked or quoted.
Confirm III rather than II for mitaʕwədiwo (JTM 1.5/10), aʕwád and maʕūdono (MAC NE Shangali Pangali/10); the existing sharpening notes overlap.
Should the lexical adjective ʕawudo (MAC NE Habirman Xatun/4) be cross-referenced separately? No Part act. box is proposed without a verbal analysis.
Does Arabic ʕayəd d- merit a separate homonym entry, or remain outside this verb glossary?
Confirm the paradigm of ʕudi at 75/193: narrative Infectum or contracted Preterit Intransitive? It is not demonstrably a reduced l-agent Preterit.
Resolve the missing cross-reference ʕwḏ and decide how to distinguish sharpening from employing within III without silently renumbering existing sense 1.
Verify the existing YT 156/04:20 and LuF 290/10 aliases against MAC YT LIFE STORY/8 and LuF 3/10; their corresponding examples are already present.
At 31/33 verify bəṯr ma ʕwodayḏi against the reader's reported alternative vowel/article sequence; no text correction is justified from the available entry.
